name: command
title: Command
description: UI SDK Command list with search, groups, empty state and Kbd shortcuts, plus a CommandDialog palette with an opt-in mod+K trigger.
docs: For a ⌘K palette: `<CommandDialog><CommandDialogTrigger shortcut="mod+k">Search<CommandDialogShortcut /></CommandDialogTrigger><CommandDialogContent title="Search"><Command onAction={…}>…</Command></CommandDialogContent></CommandDialog>`. The shortcut is opt-in, focus returns to the trigger that opened it, and `onOpenChange` reports both ways. For results from a server, use `useAsyncOptions` from `@ui-sdk/react/async-options` with `filter={false}`, `status` and `CommandStatus`; the skill's "Global search" recipe has the whole pattern. `createCommandDialogController()` opens it from code. For a second way in, like a Topbar's `centerCompact` icon, use `<CommandDialogOpenButton controller={…} aria-label="Search">`, not a second trigger: in UI SDK 0.1.0-beta.5 a second `CommandDialogTrigger` drops the dialog's agent label.
